description: This Swift source file defines the SessionManager class, which manages user session state including authentication status, tokens, and token refresh logic. It interacts with Keychain for secure token storage and with API classes for login, logout, and token refresh operations.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: A final class conforming to ObservableObject that manages user authentication sessions, including token handling, refresh logic, and interaction with secure storage.

methods.name: restoreFromKeychainIfPossible
methods.description: Restores session tokens from Keychain if available and valid, refreshing tokens if necessary.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login with email and password, persisting tokens securely and updating session state.

methods.name: authorizedRequestToken
methods.description: Returns a valid access token, refreshing it if needed, throws if not authenticated.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, invalidates session on server, and clears local secure storage and in-memory session data.

methods.name: refreshIfNeeded
methods.description: Refreshes access tokens if expired or missing, using refresh token.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Updates session tokens and expiry information with new values.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Persists current session tokens and their expiry to secure storage.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears session tokens from secure storage and resets in-memory state.
